title:
The AI guesses.
The hooman decides.
say: This is Hooman in the Loop, a free phone app for checking what an AI found in your images. You swipe to judge each result and draw to fix the mistakes. Then you export clean answers for your next model. Let me show you how it works.

title: Open it in your phone's browser
say: Open the app in your phone's browser at deke one yahav dot github dot I O slash hooman. Add it to your home screen and it works offline like any other app. There's no account and no server. Everything stays on your phone.

title: Try an example deck
say: A set of cards is called a deck. Tap Try an example and pick Model A versus model B. The first time you open a deck, the app asks for your name. That way your answers can be told apart from a colleague's.

title: Swipe to answer
say: Each card shows one cell. Model A draws its outline in red and model B in green. The dashed box shows where to look. Swipe left if A is right and right if B is right. Swipe down if you're not sure, or just use the buttons. Made a mistake? Tap undo.

title: Zoom, outlines and contrast
say: Tap the image to zoom in and pinch to look closer. The coloured chips show or hide each model's outlines. The half moon button sets the contrast, so even dim microscopy is easy to see.

title: Both wrong? Draw the right mask
say: When both models are wrong, swipe up to open the mask editor. Start from one of the models and fix what it got wrong. The magic wand fills a cell with a single tap. Cut splits cells that are stuck together and merge joins pieces. The brush, contour and polygon tools let you draw by hand. When you save, the corrected mask is stored with your answer.

title: See the results
say: The results screen shows how often each answer was given, with ninety-five percent confidence intervals. Load a colleague's export to see how much you agree and exactly which cards you disagree on.

title: Time-lapse with several channels
say: Microscopy works too. This deck has raw sixteen-bit images with three time points and two channels. You can switch between the channels, mix them in colour or put them side by side. Play runs through the time points and keeps the view you chose.

title: Make your own deck with AI
say: To make a deck from your own images, tap Make a deck with AI. Copy the prompt into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and attach your images. The AI reads the app's published format and gives you a deck to import. If you use Claude, you can add the ready-made Hooman skill.

title: Or straight from your photos
say: For a quick question you don't even need an AI. New deck from photos takes pictures from your phone and asks your question. You're swiping in seconds.

title: Export, share and back up
say: When you're done, export the answers. You get a spreadsheet, the full history and every mask you drew, ready to hand back to your AI. You can share a deck with a colleague as a file or a link, and back everything up from settings.

title: deke1yahav.github.io/hooman
say: Hooman in the Loop is free and open source. Try it today. The AI guesses. The hooman decides.
